description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG.
- After Basic Attack Stage 3, press Normal Attack in the right time to cast Mid-air Attack Stage 1.
- After Dodge Counter, Basic Attack Starfall, Resonance Skill Shewolf's Hunt, or Resonance Skill Feral Fang, press Normal Attack in time to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Heavy Attack

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.

Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing

When Wolflame reaches 50 points, Heavy Attack will be replaced by Wolf's Gnawing, consuming STA to attack the target and dealing Fusion DMG.
- This attack does not restore Wolflame. Consume 50 points of Wolflame to perform this attack and gain 1 points of Wolfaith.

Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw

When Wolflame reaches 50 points and Wolfaith reaches 1 point, Heavy Attack will be replaced by Wolf's Claw, consuming STA to attack the target and dealing Fusion DMG.
- If Wolflame reaches 50 points and Wolfaith reaches 1 point after performing Mid-air Attack - Firestrike or Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing, press Normal Attack in time to perform Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw.
- This attack does not restore Wolflame. Consume 50 points of Wolflame to perform this attack and gain 1 points of Wolfaith.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform up to 3 attacks in mid-air, dealing Fusion DMG. The Mid-air Attack cycle will not be reset.

Mid-air Attack - Firestrike

When Wolflame reaches 50 points, Mid-air Attack Stage 3 will be replaced by Mid-air Attack - Firestrike, consuming STA to attack the target and dealing Fusion DMG (considered Heavy Attack DMG).
- This attack does not restore Wolflame. Consume 50 points of Wolflame to perform this attack and gain 1 points of Wolfaith.

Plunging Attack

Hold Normal Attack while airborne to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Fusion DMG. After performing this attack, press Normal Attack in time to perform Basic Attack Starfall.
- If a Dodge is performed while casting Mid-air Attack Stage 3 or Mid-air Attack - Firestrike, press Normal Attack to perform Plunging Attack in time at the cost of STA.

Basic Attack - Starfall

Attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.

Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun, memberikan Fusion DMG.
- Setelah Basic Attack Tahap 3, tekan Normal Attack pada waktu yang tepat untuk melancarkan Mid-air Attack Tahap 1.
- Setelah Dodge Counter, Basic Attack Starfall, Resonance Skill Shewolf's Hunt, atau Resonance Skill Feral Fang, tekan Normal Attack tepat waktu untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 2.

Heavy Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG.

Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing

Saat Wolflame mencapai 50 poin, Heavy Attack digantikan oleh Wolf's Gnawing, mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target dan memberikan Fusion DMG.
- Serangan ini tidak memulihkan Wolflame. Mengonsumsi 50 poin Wolflame untuk melakukan serangan ini dan mendapat 1 poin Wolfaith.

Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw

Saat Wolflame mencapai 50 poin dan Wolfaith mencapai 1 poin, Heavy Attack digantikan oleh Wolf's Claw, mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target dan memberikan Fusion DMG.
- Jika Wolflame mencapai 50 poin dan Wolfaith mencapai 1 poin setelah melakukan Mid-air Attack - Firestrike atau Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing, tekan Normal Attack tepat waktu untuk melakukan Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw.
- Serangan ini tidak memulihkan Wolflame. Mengonsumsi 50 poin Wolflame untuk melakukan serangan ini dan mendapat 1 poin Wolfaith.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan hingga 3 serangan di udara, memberikan Fusion DMG. Siklus Mid-air Attack tidak akan direset.

Mid-air Attack - Firestrike

Saat Wolflame mencapai 50 poin, Mid-air Attack Tahap 3 digantikan oleh Mid-air Attack - Firestrike, mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target dan memberikan Fusion DMG (dianggap Heavy Attack DMG).
- Serangan ini tidak memulihkan Wolflame. Mengonsumsi 50 poin Wolflame untuk melakukan serangan ini dan mendapat 1 poin Wolfaith.

Plunging Attack

Tahan Normal Attack saat di udara untuk melakukan Plunging Attack dengan mengonsumsi STA, memberikan Fusion DMG. Setelah melakukan serangan ini, tekan Normal Attack tepat waktu untuk melakukan Basic Attack Starfall.
- Jika Dodge dilakukan saat melancarkan Mid-air Attack Tahap 3 atau Mid-air Attack - Firestrike, tekan Normal Attack untuk melakukan Plunging Attack tepat waktu dengan mengonsumsi STA.

Basic Attack - Starfall

Menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG.

Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG.

description.en:
Lupa hurls her Wildfire Banner at the target, dealing Fusion DMG and restoring 15 points of Wolflame. Mark the target for 8s. After performing Resonance Skill Shewolf's Hunt, Lupa can perform Feral Fang within a certain period of time.
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.
- Hold Resonance Skill to leap into the air, then press Normal Attack in time to cast Mid-air Attack Stage 1.

Resonance Skill - Feral Fang

Lupa locks onto a target, dealing Fusion DMG and restoring 15 points of Wolflame. The DMG Multiplier to marked targets is increased by 50%. Resonance Skill - Feral Fang enters cooldown if not cast in time or when Lupa is switched out.
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.
description.id:
Lupa melempar Wildfire Banner ke target, memberikan Fusion DMG dan memulihkan 15 poin Wolflame. Menandai target selama 8 dtk. Setelah melakukan Resonance Skill Shewolf's Hunt, Lupa dapat melakukan Feral Fang dalam jangka waktu tertentu.
Dapat dilakukan di udara dekat tanah.
- Tahan Resonance Skill untuk melompat ke udara, lalu tekan Normal Attack tepat waktu untuk melancarkan Mid-air Attack Tahap 1.

Resonance Skill - Feral Fang

Lupa mengunci target, memberikan Fusion DMG dan memulihkan 15 poin Wolflame. Pengali DMG terhadap target yang ditandai meningkat sebesar 50%. Resonance Skill - Feral Fang memasuki cooldown jika tidak dilancarkan tepat waktu atau saat Lupa diganti keluar.
Dapat dilakukan di udara dekat tanah.

description.en:
Attack the target and deal Fusion DMG. Performing this attack consumes all Wolfaith and restores 100 points of Wolflame. Use Basic Attack or Resonance Skill in time to cast Resonance Skill Foebreaker.
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.
Performing this skill strengthens all Resonators in the team. Within 35s:
- All Resonators in the team gain Pack Hunt effect.
- If the active Resonator is hit or launched into the air, they immediately recover and are considered to have successfully dodged the attack when they are on the ground. Can be triggered up to 3 times.

Pack Hunt

Resonators with Pack Hunt gain a 6% ATK increase, and 10% Fusion DMG Bonus when they attack Overlord Class or Calamity Class targets (Both are non-stackable). If there are 3 Fusion Resonators in the team, the Fusion DMG Bonus against Overlord Class or Calamity Class targets additionally increases by 10%. When the active Resonator casts Intro Skill, Pack Hunt is enhanced, granting an additional 6% ATK increase to all Resonators in the team, up to a maximum of 18%.
If Lupa's Pack Hunt reaches its cap within its duration, she enters Wild Hunt and Intro Skill Nowhere to Run! becomes available. Wild Hunt can be triggered once per Pack Hunt.

Resonance Skill - Foebreaker

Consume all Wolflame to perform Foebreaker, dealing Fusion DMG and entering Burning Matchpoint state.

Burning Matchpoint

Normal Attacks restore 500% more Wolflame on hit. Cannot perform Resonance Skill Shewolf's Hunt and Resonance Skill Feral Fang in this state.
description.id:
Menyerang target dan memberikan Fusion DMG. Melakukan serangan ini mengonsumsi seluruh Wolfaith dan memulihkan 100 poin Wolflame. Gunakan Basic Attack atau Resonance Skill tepat waktu untuk melancarkan Resonance Skill Foebreaker.
Dapat dilakukan di udara dekat tanah.
Melakukan skill ini memperkuat semua Resonator di tim. Dalam 35 dtk:
- Semua Resonator di tim mendapat efek Pack Hunt.
- Jika Resonator aktif terkena serangan atau terlempar ke udara, mereka langsung pulih dan dianggap berhasil menghindari serangan saat berada di tanah. Dapat aktif hingga 3 kali.

Pack Hunt

Resonator dengan Pack Hunt mendapat peningkatan ATK sebesar 6%, dan 10% Fusion DMG Bonus saat menyerang target Overlord Class atau Calamity Class (keduanya tidak dapat ditumpuk). Jika ada 3 Resonator Fusion di tim, Fusion DMG Bonus terhadap target Overlord Class atau Calamity Class meningkat tambahan sebesar 10%. Saat Resonator aktif melancarkan Intro Skill, Pack Hunt diperkuat, memberikan peningkatan ATK tambahan sebesar 6% kepada semua Resonator di tim, hingga maksimum 18%.
Jika Pack Hunt Lupa mencapai batas maksimum dalam durasinya, ia memasuki Wild Hunt dan Intro Skill Nowhere to Run! menjadi tersedia. Wild Hunt dapat aktif sekali per Pack Hunt.

Resonance Skill - Foebreaker

Mengonsumsi seluruh Wolflame untuk melakukan Foebreaker, memberikan Fusion DMG dan memasuki kondisi Burning Matchpoint.

Burning Matchpoint

Normal Attack memulihkan 500% lebih banyak Wolflame saat mengenai target. Tidak dapat melakukan Resonance Skill Shewolf's Hunt dan Resonance Skill Feral Fang dalam kondisi ini.

description.en:
After dashing for 2.5s, Lupa enters Sprint state. The next Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack - Starfall.
Gain increased resistance to interruptions while casting Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing, Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw, and Mid-air Attack - Firestrike.
description.id:
Setelah berlari cepat selama 2,5 dtk, Lupa memasuki kondisi Sprint. Basic Attack berikutnya digantikan oleh Basic Attack - Starfall.
Mendapat ketahanan lebih tinggi terhadap interupsi saat melancarkan Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing, Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw, dan Mid-air Attack - Firestrike.

description.en:
Defeating a marked target resets the cooldown of Resonance Skill Shewolf's Hunt.

Resonance Liberation - Glory

Casting Resonance Liberation Fire-Kissed Glory grants Glory. Within 35s:
Attacks of all Resonators in the team ignore 3% of the target's Fusion RES. For each Fusion Resonator in the team other than Lupa, this effect increases by 3%, up to the maximum of 9%. When there are 3 Fusion Resonators in the team, Resonators' attacks further ignore 6% Fusion RES.
description.id:
Mengalahkan target yang ditandai mereset cooldown Resonance Skill Shewolf's Hunt.

Resonance Liberation - Glory

Melancarkan Resonance Liberation Fire-Kissed Glory memberikan Glory. Dalam 35 dtk:
Serangan semua Resonator di tim mengabaikan 3% Fusion RES target. Untuk setiap Resonator Fusion di tim selain Lupa, efek ini meningkat sebesar 3%, hingga maksimum 9%. Saat ada 3 Resonator Fusion di tim, serangan Resonator mengabaikan tambahan 6% Fusion RES.

description.en:
Attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG. Press Normal Attack following Intro Skill Try Focusing, Eh? to cast Mid-air Attack Stage 3.

Nowhere to Run!

When Lupa enters the Wild Hunt state, her next Intro Skill is replaced with Nowhere to Run!. Casting Nowhere to Run! removes the Pack Hunt and Glory effects on all Resonators in the team, dealing Fusion DMG (considered Resonance Liberation DMG).
description.id:
Menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG. Tekan Normal Attack setelah Intro Skill Try Focusing, Eh? untuk melancarkan Mid-air Attack Tahap 3.

Nowhere to Run!

Saat Lupa memasuki kondisi Wild Hunt, Intro Skill berikutnya digantikan oleh Nowhere to Run!. Melancarkan Nowhere to Run! menghapus efek Pack Hunt dan Glory pada semua Resonator di tim, memberikan Fusion DMG (dianggap Resonance Liberation DMG).

description.en:
Wildfire Banner

Lupa's ATK is increased by 12% for 8s when performing the following actions:
- Casting Resonance Skill Feral Fang.
- Casting Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing, Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw, or Mid-air Attack - Firestrike.
- Casting Resonance Liberation Fire-Kissed Glory.
- Casting Dance With the Wolf and Dance With the Wolf: Climax.

Resonance Skill - Dance With the Wolf

When Wolfaith reaches 2 points, Resonance Skill is replaced with Dance With the Wolf. Performing Dance With the Wolf consumes all Wolfaith, dealing Fusion DMG (considered Resonance Liberation DMG).
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.

Resonance Skill - Dance With the Wolf: Climax

When Wolfaith reaches 2 points in the Burning Matchpoint state, Resonance Skill is replaced with Dance With the Wolf: Climax. Performing Dance With the Wolf: Climax consumes all Wolfaith, dealing Fusion DMG (considered Resonance Liberation DMG). Burning Matchpoint is removed when the skill ends.
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.

Resonance Skill - Set the Arena Ablaze

Within 8s after performing Dance With the Wolf or Dance With the Wolf: Climax, Lupa will remain on the field after switching to another Resonator and back up the active Resonator when they perform Resonance Liberation, dealing Fusion DMG (considered Resonance Skill DMG). This effect can only be triggered once in its duration.

Wolflame

Lupa can hold up to 100 points of Wolflame.
- Restore Wolflame when Normal Attacks hit the target.
- Restore Wolflame while casting Resonance Skill.
- Restore Wolflame while casting Resonance Liberation.

Wolfaith

Lupa can hold up to 2 points of Wolfaith.
Wolfaith lasts for 10s. The duration is reset when Wolfaith is restored. At the end of its duration, each remaining point of Wolfaith becomes 50 points of Wolflame.
- Restore 1 point of Wolfaith when casting Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing, Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw, or Mid-air Attack - Firestrike.
description.id:
Wildfire Banner

ATK Lupa meningkat sebesar 12% selama 8 dtk saat melakukan tindakan berikut:
- Melancarkan Resonance Skill Feral Fang.
- Melancarkan Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing, Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw, atau Mid-air Attack - Firestrike.
- Melancarkan Resonance Liberation Fire-Kissed Glory.
- Melancarkan Dance With the Wolf dan Dance With the Wolf: Climax.

Resonance Skill - Dance With the Wolf

Saat Wolfaith mencapai 2 poin, Resonance Skill digantikan oleh Dance With the Wolf. Melakukan Dance With the Wolf mengonsumsi seluruh Wolfaith, memberikan Fusion DMG (dianggap Resonance Liberation DMG).
Dapat dilakukan di udara dekat tanah.

Resonance Skill - Dance With the Wolf: Climax

Saat Wolfaith mencapai 2 poin dalam kondisi Burning Matchpoint, Resonance Skill digantikan oleh Dance With the Wolf: Climax. Melakukan Dance With the Wolf: Climax mengonsumsi seluruh Wolfaith, memberikan Fusion DMG (dianggap Resonance Liberation DMG). Burning Matchpoint dihapus saat skill berakhir.
Dapat dilakukan di udara dekat tanah.

Resonance Skill - Set the Arena Ablaze

Dalam 8 dtk setelah melakukan Dance With the Wolf atau Dance With the Wolf: Climax, Lupa tetap berada di lapangan setelah berganti ke Resonator lain dan mendukung Resonator aktif saat mereka melakukan Resonance Liberation, memberikan Fusion DMG (dianggap Resonance Skill DMG). Efek ini hanya dapat aktif sekali dalam durasinya.

Wolflame

Lupa dapat menyimpan hingga 100 poin Wolflame.
- Memulihkan Wolflame saat Normal Attack mengenai target.
- Memulihkan Wolflame saat melancarkan Resonance Skill.
- Memulihkan Wolflame saat melancarkan Resonance Liberation.

Wolfaith

Lupa dapat menyimpan hingga 2 poin Wolfaith.
Wolfaith bertahan selama 10 dtk. Durasi direset saat Wolfaith dipulihkan. Di akhir durasinya, setiap poin Wolfaith yang tersisa menjadi 50 poin Wolflame.
- Memulihkan 1 poin Wolfaith saat melancarkan Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing, Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw, atau Mid-air Attack - Firestrike.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Memiliki peluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: The incoming Resonator will have their Fusion DMG Amplified by 20% and Basic Attack DMG Amplified by 25% for 14s or until the Resonator is switched out.
description.id: Resonator yang masuk mendapat Amplify Fusion DMG sebesar 20% dan Amplify Basic Attack DMG sebesar 25% selama 14 dtk atau hingga Resonator diganti keluar.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en:
Performing Resonance Liberation Fire-Kissed Glory recovers 10 Concerto Energy for Lupa and increases Lupa's Crit. Rate by 20% for 10s.
Gain immunity to interruption when casting Dance With the Wolf: Climax.
description.id:
Melakukan Resonance Liberation Fire-Kissed Glory memulihkan 10 Concerto Energy untuk Lupa dan meningkatkan Crit. Rate Lupa sebesar 20% selama 10 dtk.
Mendapat kekebalan terhadap interupsi saat melancarkan Dance With the Wolf: Climax.

description.en: Performing Fire-Kissed Glory, Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing, Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw, or Mid-air Attack - Firestrike gives 20% Fusion DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30s, stacking up to 2 times.
description.id: Melakukan Fire-Kissed Glory, Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing, Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw, atau Mid-air Attack - Firestrike memberi 20% Fusion DMG Bonus kepada semua Resonator di tim selama 30 dtk, bertumpuk hingga 2 kali.

description.en:
The DMG Multiplier of Intro Skill Nowhere to Run! increases by 100%.
- The Pack Hunt effect of Resonance Liberation now no longer requires 3 Fusion Resonators.
- The Glory effect of Resonance Liberation is now modified as:
Casting Resonance Liberation Fire-Kissed Glory additionally grants Glory: Resonators in the team ignore 15% Fusion RES of targets for 35s.
description.id:
Pengali DMG Intro Skill Nowhere to Run! meningkat sebesar 100%.
- Efek Pack Hunt dari Resonance Liberation kini tidak lagi memerlukan 3 Resonator Fusion.
- Efek Glory dari Resonance Liberation kini diubah menjadi:
Melancarkan Resonance Liberation Fire-Kissed Glory juga memberikan Glory: Resonator di tim mengabaikan 15% Fusion RES target selama 35 dtk.

description.id: Pengali DMG Dance With the Wolf: Climax meningkat sebesar 125%.

description.en: Performing Intro Skill Try Focusing, Eh? or Nowhere to Run! gives 15% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus for 10s.
description.id: Melakukan Intro Skill Try Focusing, Eh? atau Nowhere to Run! memberi 15% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus selama 10 dtk.

description.en:
- The damage dealt by Forte Circuit Dance With the Wolf: Climax, Resonance Liberation Fire-Kissed Glory, and Intro Skill Nowhere to Run! ignores 30% of the target's DEF.
- Resonance Skill Feral Fang restores 100 points of Wolflame on hit, triggered once per 20s.
- Forte Circuit Dance With the Wolf is replaced with Dance With the Wolf: Climax. Dance With the Wolf: Climax can be performed when Lupa is not in Burning Matchpoint state.
- Casting Intro Skill Nowhere to Run! no longer ends Pack Hunt and Glory.
description.id:
- Damage yang diberikan oleh Forte Circuit Dance With the Wolf: Climax, Resonance Liberation Fire-Kissed Glory, dan Intro Skill Nowhere to Run! mengabaikan 30% DEF target.
- Resonance Skill Feral Fang memulihkan 100 poin Wolflame saat mengenai target, aktif sekali per 20 dtk.
- Forte Circuit Dance With the Wolf digantikan oleh Dance With the Wolf: Climax. Dance With the Wolf: Climax dapat dilakukan saat Lupa tidak dalam kondisi Burning Matchpoint.
- Melancarkan Intro Skill Nowhere to Run! tidak lagi mengakhiri Pack Hunt dan Glory.
